notes.general_comments:
This examination paper provided a difficult challenge to the candidates.
Only five questions can be said to have been found to be easier. 50% or more of candidates chose the
correct responses to each of Questions 3, 5, 7, 9, and 19. The questions at the end of the paper were
answered no better but no worse than the questions that preceded them, suggesting that most candidates
found they had sufficient time to complete the paper properly.
Nine questions can be said to have been found to be particularly difficult. 25% or less of candidates chose
the correct responses to each of Questions 8, 10, 14, 17, 21, 23, 33, 35 and 40.
